domain_label: Sweater Finishing & Post-Treatment — Per-Article Recipe and Make-vs-Outsource Boundary
purpose: A session-bounded method for a small AI-designed D2C knitwear brand manufacturing in/through Ludhiana and selling in warm-ish California/Turlock to design the per-article finishing recipe for its three-article line (A1 cotton-blend core, A2 fine-acrylic value, A3 merino/lambswool premium), resolve the make-vs-outsource boundary (outsource 100% of wet/regulated finishing, own only the two-PO recipe and the finished-garment post-wash test gate), and price finishing as a labeled minority cost slice while naming the per-garment job-work rate as a genuine UNKNOWN blocker. The recurring decisions are which anti-pill route attaches to which fibre, where each grade is won (the yarn PO vs the finishing line), and how the eight-check post-wash gate codes back to the named supplier.
assumptions: no per-vendor Ludhiana finishing quote is supplied; cost bands and route availability are reasoned estimates keyed to the finishing deep-dive, not invoices
the brand runs the three-article warm-California line from the yarn deep-dive: A1 cotton-blend 12GG core, A2 fine-acrylic 7-12GG value, A3 merino/lambswool 7-12GG seasonal premium
finishing is the second line of pilling defence; the yarn PO sets the floor (five spinning dials + ICI Pilling-Box >=3-4 post-wash), and these recipes build on that floor rather than replacing it
supplier-to-named-process links are representative inference, not confirmed job-work contracts, unless the deep-dive cites the relationship
the brand owns no wet-processing or dyeing node and does not intend to, per the T1 NGT/CETP/closure-risk posture and the T2 contractual-QC posture
every cost, temperature, time, and dose band is a labeled estimate; the per-garment finishing job-work rate is a genuine UNKNOWN that blocks the T4 bottom-up model
exclusions: per-vendor finishing job-work rates stated as fact (only labeled estimate bands and the named UNKNOWN blocker are used)
the yarn fibre/count/blend line decision itself (covered by the yarn KBs; this KB consumes the yarn PO as a precondition)
the finished-garment defect-detection device/loop mechanics and AQL plan internals (covered by the quality-checker KB; this KB defines only the finishing-side gate it feeds)
owning, building, or operating any dyehouse, effluent treatment, singe range, enzyme bath, milling machine, or compactor (the make decision is settled as outsource; capex/ownership is out of scope)
landed-cost, duty, and unit-economics modelling (covered by the logistics KB; this KB supplies only the labeled finishing cost slice)
brand care-label marketing copy and the softener-vs-breathable-story brand decision beyond naming it as a downstream input

competency_questions.question: Why is finishing the second line of pilling defence and not the first, and what does finishing genuinely own for every article regardless of fibre?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: FINISHING_THESIS states that the yarn PO sets the floor (five spinning dials + ICI >=3-4 post-wash) and finishing is fibre-route-specific, and names what finishing owns for every article: the retail hand and the home-wash dimensional experience

competency_questions.question: What is the post-knit finishing chain, and which steps do not apply to every garment?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: FINISHING_CHAIN lays out scour -> (wool-only mill) -> anti-pill route -> soften -> dry -> press/board -> relax/shrink-control -> gate, marking milling as wool-only and mercerise/singe as yarn-stage up-position

competency_questions.question: What are the four real anti-pill routes, and which fibre does each attach to (and why is there no universal anti-pill finish)?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ANTIPILL_ROUTES enumerates singeing/gassing (cotton, yarn-stage), cellulase bio-polish (cotton/cellulosics only), chemical/silicone (acrylic primary), and low-pill fibre choice (upstream, not a finish), and states that writing a generic anti-pill finish across fibres is a category error

competency_questions.question: What is the A1 cotton-blend finishing recipe, and why is it the highest return-on-finishing article?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: A1_COTTON_RECIPE specifies gas-singe (yarn) + cellulase bio-polish (garment) with a mandatory retained-strength cap, hydrophilic softener, steam-press, wet-relax/compact, ICI >=3-4, and explains it earns the entire home-wash promise plus a real anti-pill uplift

competency_questions.question: What is the A2 fine-acrylic recipe, and why is its ICI grade won or lost at the yarn PO rather than the finishing line?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: A2_ACRYLIC_RECIPE states acrylic is thermoplastic (cannot be cleanly singed) and non-cellulosic (cellulase does nothing), so finishing buys only a chemical/silicone fraction of a grade; if forced onto cheap acrylic, re-open the yarn spec rather than pile on anti-pill

competency_questions.question: What is the A3 wool/lambswool recipe, and how does it reach ICI >=4 with a soft hand?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: A3_WOOL_RECIPE specifies buy-the-craft milling + boarding + felt-relax with a few-% nylon upstream, gated on a milling felt/area-shrink limit not a clock, amino-silicone softener, ICI >=4, and flags in-cluster wool-finishing skill/capacity as the real risk

competency_questions.question: How is the make-vs-outsource boundary resolved, and why is 100% of wet/regulated finishing outsourced with no owned dyehouse or effluent node?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: OUTSOURCE_BOUNDARY resolves to outsource every wet/skilled/regulated step (regulatory/effluent NGT-closure risk, capital+skill, idle-at-micro-volume, agglomeration tailwind) and own only the two-PO recipe + the finished-garment gate

competency_questions.question: Why does the recipe span two purchase orders, and what does each PO carry?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: TWO_PO_STRUCTURE states the yarn PO carries singe/mercerise/anti-pill grade/nylon% and the finishing PO carries scour/bio-polish/mill/soften/press/relax, and that both POs must carry the same post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate so a step skipped at one vendor cannot pass the test at the other

competency_questions.question: How is the bio-polish strength cap specified so de-fuzzing does not weaken the cotton garment into returns?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BIOPOLISH_STRENGTH_CAP requires the spec to name both the target hand and a minimum retained bursting/tensile strength, and to inactivate the cellulase enzyme (alkali/heat) afterwards or it keeps eating cellulose

competency_questions.question: How is milling gated so it does not irreversibly felt the wool garment, and why is time the dial?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MILLING_GATE states milling is wool-only and irreversible, the same physics as accidental shrink-felting stopped at a target, gated on dimensions + a felt/area-shrink limit + hand never to the clock, with time the short (minutes) dial

competency_questions.question: How does softening deliver the retail hand without masking a harsh yarn, and which softener chemistry per article?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SOFTENER_HAND requires a wash-durable softener tested after a wash not in the showroom, hydrophilic silicone on breathable cotton (A1), amino-silicone on wool (A3), and flags the masking trap

competency_questions.question: How do pressing/boarding and relax/compact deliver the tech-pack measurements and the home-wash dimensional promise?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PRESS_BOARD sets final dimensions under steam (critical for the A3 fully-fashioned read) and RELAX_SHRINK_CONTROL spends relaxation shrinkage in the factory then compacts to a +/-3-5% residual limit, spirality flagged as the balanced-ply sister fault

competency_questions.question: What is the dye-stage choice, why is the dye node never owned, and what QC travels in the PO at whatever stage?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DYE_STAGE_CHOICE launches yarn/package-dyed (bought-dyed stock shades) for consistency + patterning, reserves garment-dye for a later proven hero style, never piece-dye-and-cut as core, never owns the dye node (T1), and carries lot-to-lot delta-E + wash/rub/light fastness minima in the PO

competency_questions.question: How is finishing priced honestly as a minority slice, and which number is a genuine UNKNOWN that blocks the T4 model?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: COST_BENCHMARK_HONESTY holds the ~$0.25-1.80/garment band as a labeled estimate minority slice with the A3>A1>A2 ordering, and JOBWORK_RATE_BLOCKER names the per-garment Ludhiana job-work rate as UNKNOWN blocking the T4 bottom-up model, sister to the linking rate and dye-lot MOQ

glossary.definition: The principle that finishing reduces pilling only after the yarn PO has set the floor with the five spinning dials and the ICI Pilling-Box >=3-4 post-wash gate; finishing delivers a real extra grade on cotton, a fraction on acrylic, and a craft uplift on wool, but cannot fix a high-pill yarn.

One of four real routes each tied to a fibre: gas-singeing (cotton, yarn-stage), cellulase bio-polish (cotton/cellulosics only), chemical/silicone (acrylic primary), and low-pill fibre choice (upstream, not a finish); there is no universal anti-pill finish, and writing one generically across fibres is a category error.

A wet enzyme step that hydrolyses protruding cellulosic micro-fibrils so light abrasion snaps them off, giving durable pill reduction and a softer cotton hand; it removes fibre so it costs tensile strength and must be inactivated (alkali/heat) afterwards or it keeps eating cellulose.

A yarn-stage step passing the yarn through a gas flame to burn off protruding surface fuzz, cutting pill anchors on cotton and cotton-rich blends; it lives in the yarn PO, not the finishing line, and pairs with mercerising as the gassed-and-mercerised premium-cotton combo.

Controlled wet + heat + agitation that felts and closes up a woollen knit into a fuller, softer, warmer hand; it is the same physics as accidental shrink-felting deliberately stopped at a target, irreversible if over-done, gated on a felt/area-shrink limit not a clock, with time the short (minutes) dial.

A bio-polish acceptance limit that names both the target hand and a minimum retained bursting/tensile strength, because the enzyme de-fuzzes by removing fibre; over-treating makes the cotton sweater weak, thin, and returnable.

The finishing recipe split across two purchase orders: the yarn PO carries singe/mercerise/anti-pill grade/nylon%, and the finishing PO carries scour/bio-polish/mill/soften/press/relax; both must carry the same post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate so a step skipped at one vendor cannot pass the test at the other.

The box pilling test used for soft whole-garment sweater knits (not the Martindale ISO 12945-2), run ~2000 revolutions and graded 1 (severe) to 5 (none) to the nearest half-grade after >=1 home wash; the post-wash grade is the one that predicts returns, and the method must be specified alongside the number.

Stored knit stress released the first time the fabric is wetted, common to all fibres and non-reversible; spent in the factory via wet/tumble/kier-relax then compacted (sanforised) to a residual-shrink limit (working target +/-3-5%) and steam-set to lock it, rather than at the customer's washing machine.

The make-vs-outsource posture inherited from T1 (never own a dyehouse or effluent node) and T2 (contractual QC, not in-house metrology): outsource 100% of wet/skilled/regulated finishing and own only the two-PO tech-pack recipe and the finished-garment post-wash acceptance gate; leverage is contractual and relational, never a device.

nodes.definition: Pin down the governing thesis: finishing is the SECOND line of pilling defence, never the first. The yarn PO (T2) sets the floor with the five spinning dials (staple, twist, ply, fineness, blend ratio) and the contractual ICI Pilling-Box >=3-4 post-wash gate; finishing then either delivers a real extra grade (cotton A1) or only a cosmetic fraction (acrylic A2). What finishing genuinely OWNS for every article regardless of fibre is the retail hand (how the sweater feels in the customer's hands) and the home-wash dimensional experience (whether it holds size after the customer washes it). The governing fault stated plainly: a recipe that promises finishing will fix a cheap yarn is the single most expensive spec lie in knitwear -- a premium showroom sample that pills and bags out one wash later, with the returns landing on the brand. This thesis [ESTIMATE: process-reasoning, HIGH] bounds every recipe and route choice downstream.

nodes.definition: Lay out the post-knit finishing sequence so every step has a place and the not-every-garment steps are marked: knit panels -> linking/assembly -> scour/wash -> (WOOL ONLY) mill/full -> anti-pill route (per fibre) -> soften -> extract/dry -> steam-press / board / block -> relax & shrink-control -> final QC gate. Each step does one job for the garment: scour strips spinning oils and lubricants so later finishes deposit evenly; milling felts and closes up a woollen knit (wool only); the anti-pill route is fibre-matched; softening gives the expensive hand but can mask a harsh yarn; pressing/boarding sets final dimensions and is where the tech-pack measurements are hit; relax/compact spends relaxation shrinkage in the factory. Singeing and mercerising are yarn-stage up-positions, not finisher steps, and dyeing is a stage-of-chain choice handled separately. Step identities are [FACT -- wet-processing sequence]; 'not every garment uses every step' is [ESTIMATE: process-reasoning, HIGH].

nodes.definition: Enumerate the four real anti-pill routes, each attached to a specific fibre, and state plainly that there is no universal anti-pill finish. Route 1 -- singeing/gassing (yarn-stage): a gas flame burns off protruding surface fuzz, cutting pill anchors on cotton and cotton-rich/viscose blends [FACT]. Route 2 -- cellulase bio-polish (fabric/garment wet step): an enzyme hydrolyses protruding cellulosic micro-fibrils for durable pill reduction and a softer hand on COTTON/CELLULOSICS ONLY -- it does nothing on acrylic or wool [FACT]. Route 3 -- chemical/silicone anti-pill: a polymer/resin/silicone anchors surface fibres, ACRYLIC primary, wool/cotton adjunct, buying only a fraction of a grade and risking a stiffer hand [ESTIMATE: industry-lore, MED-HIGH]. Route 4 -- low-pill fibre choice (upstream, NOT a finish): higher-dpf/anti-pill acrylic grade, longer staple, a few % nylon in soft-wool blends, tighter twist and gauge -- the biggest single lever, set in the yarn PO [ESTIMATE: industry-lore, HIGH]. Writing a generic anti-pill finish across cotton/acrylic/wool is a category error that produces either a no-op or damage.

nodes.definition: Establish the one structural fact that shapes the whole contract: the recipe spans TWO purchase orders, not one. Singeing and mercerising happen at the YARN supplier (yarn PO: singe / mercerise / anti-pill grade / nylon%); the wet and mechanical steps happen at the garment knitter/finisher (finishing PO: scour / bio-polish / mill / soften / press / relax). Both POs must carry the SAME post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate -- or a step skipped at one vendor quietly passes the test at the other (test only the yarn and a loose knit or skipped finish fails; test only the garment and a bad yarn passes one lab dip). This two-PO split [ESTIMATE: design-framing, HIGH] is the precondition for the consolidated tech-pack and the eight-check gate, and it is what makes the finishing gate the garment-side half of the per-lot QC scorecard the yarn side opened.

nodes.definition: Resolve the make-vs-outsource call: outsource 100% of wet / skilled / regulated finishing; own only (a) the recipe in the two-PO tech-pack and (b) the finished-garment post-wash test gate. This is the same posture as T2 on yarn (contractual QC, not in-house metrology) and T1 on dyeing (never own a dyehouse). Why outsource every wet step, not just dyeing: REGULATORY/EFFLUENT -- wet processing makes effluent, the cluster's CETPs were found non-compliant with crore-scale CPCB penalties and an NGT review, so owning ANY wet node imports closure risk wildly out of proportion to a three-article line [FACT -- T1]; CAPITAL+SKILL -- singe ranges, strength-controlled enzyme baths, milling machines, boarding forms, and compactors are equipment-heavy and skill-bound [ESTIMATE, HIGH]; VOLUME -- at micro-capsule volume in-house kit sits idle, outsourcing converts a fixed-cost machine into a per-garment job-work charge [ESTIMATE, HIGH]; AGGLOMERATION -- Ludhiana's walking-distance job-work mesh is built to rent exactly these steps [FACT -- T1]. The brand never owns a dyehouse or any effluent node.

nodes.definition: Specify the first wet step on the finishing PO: scour/wash strips spinning oils, knit lubricants (paraffin/wax), sizing, and lint so later finishes deposit EVENLY and the loops relax. Under-scouring is the quiet upstream failure -- a finish applied over residual oil goes on blotchy, producing patchy softener uptake and shade unevenness that only surface after the finish is committed. Scour is common to all three articles and precedes the anti-pill route, softening, and the wool-only milling step. The wet-processing sequence identity is [FACT]; the patchy-uptake consequence is [ESTIMATE: process-reasoning, HIGH]. Scour is outsourced like every wet step (OUTSOURCE_BOUNDARY); the brand owns only the requirement that it be adequate, verified downstream by the even-deposit evidence in the hand and shade checks of the gate.

nodes.definition: Specify the ONE dial that decides A1's pass/fail: the cellulase bio-polish strength cap. Bio-polish removes fibre -- that is how it de-fuzzes -- so it COSTS tensile strength. The enzyme MUST be inactivated (alkali/heat) afterwards or it keeps eating cellulose and strength loss runs away. This is the cotton (cellulosics-only) garment wet step, durable and non-greasy, that with yarn-stage singeing gives A1 a real, ownable, verifiable anti-pill route -- the article where finishing earns its keep. Strength-loss risk and the inactivation requirement are [FACT]; the exact grade uplift on our constructions is [UNKNOWN until PPS swatch testing], so keep the direction HIGH and the magnitude LOW.

nodes.definition: Define the loop that keeps the two-PO tech-pack alive: a per-lot acceptance review (the eight-check gate coding back to the named supplier) plus a periodic recipe review, and the material-change triggers that send the brand back through the thesis and the per-article recipes to re-plan -- a post-wash gate failure (pilling, shrinkage, retained strength, felt), a resolved UNKNOWN (a live per-garment job-work quote, confirmed local singe/bio-polish or wool-milling capacity), PPS swatch testing quantifying a route's grade uplift, a fibre/blend change, a buyer tightening the residual-shrink or pilling bar, or a cluster regulatory shift on the dye/effluent node. Without this loop the recipe silently drifts out of quality and honesty alignment -- a route assumed available that is not, or a placeholder cost treated as measured. The loop is the mechanism that upgrades UNKNOWNs to facts and re-runs the affected recipe rather than fabricating the gap.

A1 invests heavily in finishing (a real grade) while A2 deliberately finishes light, competing for where finishing spend and attention go
edges.resolution_rule: spec A1 fully because finishing earns a real ownable grade there; finish A2 light and win its grade at the yarn PO, never piling chemical anti-pill on cheap acrylic

edges.why_related: garment-dye's agility tempts owning or pulling the dye node closer, against the never-own-a-dyehouse boundary
edges.resolution_rule: always outsource the dye node (T1 NGT/closure risk); buy agility only via a later garment-dye job-work drop on a proven hero, never by owning the node

edges.why_related: heavy softening can mask a harsh yarn and create a premium showroom sample that contradicts the second-line thesis
edges.resolution_rule: spec a wash-durable softener and test the hand after a wash, never letting softening substitute for the yarn-PO floor

edges.why_related: the bio-polish dose causally drives the retained-strength gate result it is capped against

conflict_axes.name: finish_to_a_real_grade_vs_finish_light
conflict_axes.description: A1 cotton earns a real ownable anti-pill grade from finishing while A2 acrylic's grade is won at the yarn PO and finishing buys only a fraction, so finishing spend and attention compete between the two articles.
poles: finish light and win upstream (A2 acrylic)
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: invest finishing where it earns a real grade (cotton singe + bio-polish); finish acrylic light and re-open the yarn spec rather than pile on anti-pill

conflict_axes.name: own_the_process_vs_own_the_spec_and_gate
conflict_axes.description: Owning a wet/finishing node would give process control but imports effluent/closure risk and idle capital, against owning only the two-PO recipe and the gate.
poles: own a wet/finishing node for control
outsource all wet, own only spec + gate
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: outsource 100% of wet/regulated finishing and recover control through the spec and the eight-check gate; leverage is contractual, not a machine

conflict_axes.name: de_fuzz_aggressively_vs_retain_strength
conflict_axes.description: Bio-polish de-fuzzes cotton by removing fibre, so a softer lower-pill hand competes head-on with retained tensile/bursting strength.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: spec both a target hand and a minimum retained strength and inactivate the enzyme; stop at the strength floor even short of the softest hand

conflict_axes.name: full_milled_hand_vs_irreversible_felt
conflict_axes.description: Milling a fuller warmer wool hand competes against the irreversible over-felting that is the most destructive finishing failure.
poles: mill to a fuller warmer hand
stop short to avoid irreversible felt
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: gate milling on a felt/area-shrink limit + dimensions + hand, never a clock; time is the short irreversible dial

conflict_axes.name: luxe_hand_softener_vs_breathable_durable_hand
conflict_axes.description: Amino-silicone gives a luxe hand but carries hydrophobicity/yellowing and can mask a harsh yarn, against a wash-durable breathable hand on cotton.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: amino-silicone on wool where luxe is wanted, hydrophilic on breathable cotton, and test the hand after a wash to defeat masking

conflict_axes.name: colour_consistency_fastness_vs_dye_agility
conflict_axes.description: Yarn/package-dyed gives consistency, fastness, and patterning but commits early, while garment-dye gives agility and vintage hand at the cost of measurement shift and weak fastness.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: launch yarn/package-dyed (bought-dyed) with a delta-E clause; reserve garment-dye for a later proven hero, never the launch default, never owning the node

conflict_axes.name: spend_relaxation_in_factory_vs_loose_residual_limit
conflict_axes.description: Tightly spending relaxation shrinkage and compacting to a tight residual limit protects the home-wash promise but costs more than a loose factory target.
poles: compact to a tight residual limit
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: spend relaxation shrinkage in the factory and confirm the residual limit per buyer, tightening for a tumble-dry US household

conflict_axes.name: labeled_estimate_band_vs_fake_precise_point
conflict_axes.description: A defensible cost band competes with the temptation to state a fake-precise per-garment finishing point that the T4 model could consume.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: carry ~$0.25-1.80/garment as a labeled estimate with A3>A1>A2 ordering and hold the per-garment job-work rate UNKNOWN until a live quote

conflict_axes.name: test_both_ends_vs_test_one_end
conflict_axes.description: Carrying the same post-wash gate on both POs catches a skipped step at either vendor but adds coordination, against testing only one end for simplicity.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: carry the identical post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate on both the yarn and finishing PO so a skipped step cannot pass at the other vendor

edge_cases.description: A heavily-softened showroom sample feels premium then pills and bags out one home wash later
edge_cases.trigger: a recipe or sample lets softening mask a harsh yarn or finishing promises to fix a cheap yarn
edge_cases.mitigation: test hand and pilling after the same home wash as the gate, never in the showroom, and fix the floor at the yarn PO

edge_cases.description: Cellulase bio-polish is over-dosed or not inactivated so the cotton garment is weak, thin, and returnable
edge_cases.trigger: bio-polish run past the retained-strength cap or the enzyme left active
edge_cases.mitigation: spec a minimum retained bursting/tensile strength vs baseline and inactivate the enzyme (alkali/heat) after de-fuzzing

edge_cases.description: A wool garment is milled to irreversible felt by running to a clock instead of a felt limit
edge_cases.trigger: milling timed rather than gated on dimensions + area-shrink + hand
edge_cases.mitigation: gate milling on a felt/area-shrink limit + dimensions + hand, never a clock, and stop at the target

edge_cases.description: Local gas-singe + cellulase bio-polish job-work does not exist in-cluster at our MOQ/price, so A1's real route is unbuyable
edge_cases.trigger: the A1 anti-pill route is specced assuming local job-work whose availability is UNKNOWN
edge_cases.mitigation: design around by buying pre-singed/mercerised yarn and confirming or skipping local bio-polish, and keep the availability UNKNOWN flagged

edge_cases.description: A cheap acrylic is forced on the line and the brand piles on chemical anti-pill to rescue the grade
edge_cases.trigger: an attempt to fix A2 pilling at the finishing line rather than the yarn PO
edge_cases.mitigation: re-open the yarn spec to an anti-pill/high-dpf grade; do not pile chemical anti-pill on a thermoplastic non-cellulosic base

edge_cases.description: A step is skipped at one vendor and quietly passes the test at the other because the gate is on only one PO
edge_cases.trigger: the post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate is carried on the yarn PO or the finishing PO but not both
edge_cases.mitigation: carry the identical post-wash gate on both POs so neither vendor can pass on the other's defect

edge_cases.description: In-cluster wool-milling capacity is thin or seasonal so the low-volume A3 capsule cannot buy the craft
edge_cases.trigger: an A3 drop scheduled when felt-control milling job-work is unavailable
edge_cases.mitigation: confirm a specialist wool finisher's capacity and felt-control before committing the A3 drop, and treat capacity as a flagged UNKNOWN

edge_cases.description: A garment-dye drop on a fine 12GG knit shifts the final measurements via dye-bath shrinkage
edge_cases.trigger: garment-dye used as a launch default rather than a later proven hero with a sample trial
edge_cases.mitigation: launch yarn/package-dyed; run a sample dye trial before any garment-dye hero drop and never own the dye node

edge_cases.description: A placeholder per-garment finishing cost is fed as a point into the T4 bottom-up model
edge_cases.trigger: the labeled estimate band is quoted as a measured cost without a live quote
edge_cases.mitigation: carry the band as a labeled estimate and hold the per-garment job-work rate UNKNOWN until a named-finisher live quote replaces it

edge_cases.description: Pilling is graded on ISO 12945-2 Martindale on soft whole-garment knits it does not suit, or before a wash
edge_cases.trigger: the wrong pilling method or a pre-wash grade is used
edge_cases.mitigation: grade on ISO 12945-1 box method post-1-wash to the half-grade and state the method alongside the number

edge_cases.description: Under-scouring leaves residual oil so the softener and bio-polish deposit blotchy and the shade is uneven
edge_cases.trigger: scour skipped or inadequate before the finishing wet steps
edge_cases.mitigation: specify adequate scour as the first wet step and tie it to the gate's hand and shade checks

workflow.action: Anchor the second-line thesis and what finishing owns
workflow.description: State that the yarn PO sets the floor and finishing owns the hand + home-wash promise, fibre-route-specific
workflow.gate: the thesis names the yarn-PO floor, the fibre-route-specificity, and the hand + home-wash as what finishing owns

workflow.action: Lay out the finishing chain and the anti-pill routes
workflow.description: Order the post-knit chain and map the four fibre-matched anti-pill routes with the no-universal-finish rule
workflow.gate: the chain is ordered with conditional steps marked and all four routes are tied to their fibre

workflow.action: Split the recipe across the two POs
workflow.description: Allocate singe/mercerise/grade/nylon% to the yarn PO and scour/bio-polish/mill/soften/press/relax to the finishing PO
workflow.gate: the two POs are split and the identical post-wash gate is required on both

workflow.description: Settle outsource 100% of wet/regulated finishing and own only the two-PO recipe + gate, with the four reasons
workflow.gate: the boundary outsources all wet (no owned dyehouse/effluent node) and keeps only the recipe + gate

workflow.description: Spec scour, the strength-capped bio-polish, the milling felt-gate, the softener chemistry, pressing/boarding, and relax/compact
workflow.gate: each step has its dial set (strength cap, felt limit, wash-durable softener, residual-shrink limit)

workflow.description: Build the A1 (spec fully), A2 (finish light), and A3 (buy the craft) recipes with per-article ICI bars
workflow.gate: all three recipes are specified with their pass/fail dial and ICI bar (A1/A2 >=3-4, A3 >=4)

workflow.action: Bind the pilling method and the dye-stage choice
workflow.description: Gate pilling on ISO 12945-1 post-wash and choose launch yarn/package-dyed with delta-E + fastness clauses
workflow.gate: the pilling method is ISO 12945-1 post-wash and the dye stage launches bought-dyed, never owning the node

workflow.description: List the eight post-wash checks feeding the scorecard-and-code to the named supplier, carried on both POs
workflow.gate: all eight checks are specified post-wash with per-article bars and carried identically on both POs

workflow.action: Price finishing as a labeled minority slice
workflow.description: Carry ~$0.25-1.80/garment as a labeled estimate with the A3>A1>A2 ordering, not a point for T4
workflow.gate: every finishing cost is a labeled estimate band marked not-a-point-for-T4 until a live quote

workflow.action: Name the per-garment job-work rate as the T4 blocker
workflow.description: Hold the per-garment Ludhiana finishing rate UNKNOWN, sister to the linking rate and dye-lot MOQ, with the two adjacent route-availability UNKNOWNs
workflow.gate: the per-garment job-work rate is UNKNOWN and named as the T4 blocker, none fabricated

workflow.action: Consolidate the two-PO tech-pack and set the review loop
workflow.description: Integrate both PO halves, the three recipes, the gate, the dye clauses, and the cost slice, then set the per-lot + periodic review
workflow.gate: the tech-pack integrates both POs with the gate on both and a review cadence with material-change triggers exists

priority_rationale: The second-line thesis, the finishing chain + anti-pill routes, the two-PO structure, and the outsource boundary come first because every recipe and gate decision depends on knowing that the yarn PO sets the floor, that routes are fibre-matched, that the recipe spans two POs, and that all wet steps are outsourced; the finishing-PO step specs and the three per-article recipes build the operating recipe; the pilling method, dye-stage, and eight-check gate compose the acceptance system; the labeled cost slice and the named job-work UNKNOWN keep it honest; the consolidated two-PO tech-pack integrates everything into the artifact the brand owns; and the review loop comes last because it watches the whole tech-pack and routes material changes back to the thesis and recipes.

dominance_rules.rule: Effluent/regulatory outsourcing dominates any in-house finishing control
dominance_rules.rationale: owning any wet/effluent node imports cluster NGT/CETP closure risk wildly out of proportion to a three-article line
dominance_rules.trigger: any plan to own, build, or pull in a wet/finishing/dye node
dominance_rules.action: outsource the wet step and recover control through the spec and gate instead

dominance_rules.rule: The yarn-PO floor dominates any finishing rescue of a cheap yarn
dominance_rules.rationale: finishing is the second line of pilling defence and cannot fix a high-pill yarn; promising it is the most expensive spec lie
dominance_rules.trigger: a recipe or sample promises finishing will fix a cheap yarn
dominance_rules.action: re-open the yarn spec to set the floor, then finish to the ceiling

dominance_rules.rule: Retained-strength and felt limits dominate de-fuzz and milling intensity
dominance_rules.rationale: over-bio-polished cotton is returnable and over-milled wool is irreversibly felted, both worse than a slightly less soft hand
dominance_rules.trigger: a step is pushed past its strength or felt/area-shrink limit
dominance_rules.action: stop at the retained-strength floor or felt limit even short of the softest/fullest hand

dominance_rules.rule: Honesty labeling dominates any finishing cost figure
dominance_rules.rationale: a fake-precise per-garment finishing point fed into T4 violates the honesty discipline and misleads the bottom-up model
dominance_rules.trigger: any per-garment finishing cost about to be stated as a point
dominance_rules.action: express it as a labeled estimate band and hold the job-work rate UNKNOWN until a live quote

dominance_rules.rule: The same gate on both POs dominates single-end testing
dominance_rules.rationale: testing only one end lets a skipped step pass at the other vendor, so a bad yarn or a skipped finish slips through
dominance_rules.trigger: the post-wash gate is about to be carried on only one PO
dominance_rules.action: carry the identical post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate on both POs

dominance_rules.rule: Post-wash testing dominates showroom or pre-wash assessment
dominance_rules.rationale: washing drops the pilling grade and exposes masking and relaxation shrinkage, and the post-wash result is what predicts returns
dominance_rules.trigger: a hand, pilling, or shrinkage check is run in the showroom or before a wash
dominance_rules.action: run the check after the same home wash the gate specifies

dominance_rules.rule: Bought-dyed launch dominates garment-dye agility for the core
dominance_rules.rationale: garment-dye shifts measurements and weakens fastness, a risk a tiny brand cannot eat on the launch core
dominance_rules.trigger: garment-dye is proposed as the launch default
dominance_rules.action: launch yarn/package-dyed and reserve garment-dye for a later proven hero on a sample trial

dominance_rules.rule: A confirmed in-cluster route dominates an assumed one
dominance_rules.rationale: an A1 bio-polish or A3 milling route assumed available but absent in-cluster strands the recipe
dominance_rules.trigger: a recipe depends on local singe/bio-polish or wool-milling job-work whose availability is UNKNOWN
dominance_rules.action: confirm the route in-cluster or design around it, keeping the availability UNKNOWN flagged

dominance_rules.rule: Spending relaxation shrinkage in the factory dominates pushing it to the customer
dominance_rules.rationale: relaxation shrinkage is non-reversible, so releasing it at the customer's wash bags or shrinks the garment into returns
dominance_rules.trigger: a recipe leaves relaxation shrinkage unspent
dominance_rules.action: wet/tumble/kier-relax and compact to the residual limit in the factory and steam-set to lock it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Settle the outsource boundary and the two-PO split before specifying any step
anti_rework_rules.prevents: designing an in-house wet step that imports effluent risk or mis-allocating singe/mercerise to the wrong PO

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the yarn-PO floor before leaning on finishing for pilling
anti_rework_rules.prevents: over-investing finishing to rescue a yarn the PO should have fixed, then re-sourcing later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the bio-polish retained-strength cap and enzyme inactivation before the first cotton lot
anti_rework_rules.prevents: weak, thin, returnable cotton garments from a runaway de-fuzz

anti_rework_rules.rule: Gate milling on a felt/area-shrink limit before the first wool lot
anti_rework_rules.prevents: irreversibly over-felted wool from running milling to a clock

anti_rework_rules.rule: Carry the identical post-wash gate on both POs when first written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a skipped step passing at the vendor whose PO omitted the gate

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm local singe/bio-polish and wool-milling job-work availability before committing a route
anti_rework_rules.prevents: stranding an A1 or A3 recipe on an in-cluster route that does not exist

anti_rework_rules.rule: Label every finishing cost figure estimate-not-point and hold the job-work rate UNKNOWN
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a placeholder band being consumed as a measured point by the T4 model

anti_rework_rules.rule: Choose the launch dye stage as yarn/package-dyed before sizing colours
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a garment-dye measurement-shift or piece-dye-and-cut quality miss on the launch core

iteration_protocol.trigger: a fibre or blend on an article changes
iteration_protocol.action: re-apply the second-line thesis and re-run the affected per-article recipe and its anti-pill route

iteration_protocol.trigger: a post-wash gate check fails (pilling, shrinkage, retained strength, or felt)
iteration_protocol.action: trace to the responsible step, adjust its dial, and re-run the gate and the affected recipe

iteration_protocol.trigger: a live named-finisher per-garment job-work quote arrives
iteration_protocol.action: replace the labeled band, unblock the T4 line item, and update the tech-pack cost hook

iteration_protocol.trigger: local singe/bio-polish or wool-milling job-work availability is confirmed or denied in-cluster
iteration_protocol.action: lock or design around the A1/A3 route and update the recipe and tech-pack

iteration_protocol.trigger: PPS swatch testing quantifies a route's grade uplift
iteration_protocol.action: recalibrate the achievable ICI bar and the recipe's anti-pill reliance

iteration_protocol.trigger: the buyer tightens the residual-shrink or pilling bar, or a cluster regulatory shift hits the dye/effluent node
iteration_protocol.action: re-set the relax/compact limit or the dye-stage choice and re-confirm the outsource boundary

iteration_protocol.trigger: a proven hero style justifies a garment-dye trial
iteration_protocol.action: run a sample dye trial for measurement shift and fastness before committing, never owning the node
